responsibility: Defines the low-level bridge from gm2 diagnostics to GCC’s emission and location machinery. It exports routines to emit errors, warnings, and notes at token positions, raise internal errors, and obtain unknown/builtins locations, making it the narrow abstraction layer that shields the rest of the front end from direct `m2linemap` and GCC diagnostic calls.
same_name_distinction: This definition module is the narrow published interface from gm2 diagnostics to GCC emission, exporting `EmitError`, `InternalError`, and location accessors. The paired `M2Emit.mod` supplies the concrete bindings to `M2LexBuf.TokenToLocation` and `m2linemap` diagnostic routines.
